questions.subject: Oral pathology
questions.q: Which tooth is most commonly impacted after the third molars?
questions.explain: The maxillary canine is the most common impacted tooth after third molars.

questions.subject: Oral histology
questions.explain: Odontoblasts differentiate from dental papilla cells and deposit dentin.

questions.subject: Dental materials
questions.q: Which restorative material chemically bonds to tooth structure and releases fluoride?
questions.explain: Glass ionomer cement adheres chemically to enamel and dentin and releases fluoride.

questions.subject: Periodontics
questions.q: Which factor is the primary cause of plaque-induced gingivitis?
questions.explain: Plaque-induced gingivitis is caused by bacterial biofilm; other factors modify the response.
